turns.prompt_text: can you make printer ink from black walnut Inc
turns.response_html: You can make ink from black walnut hulls for traditional uses like calligraphy or art, but this homemade ink is not suitable for modern printers. The natural ink contains particles that would clog and damage the small, precise nozzles of inkjet printers.

turns.prompt_text: can black walnut Inc be made suitable for modern printers
turns.response_html: It is highly improbable to make black walnut ink suitable for modern inkjet printers. Homemade walnut ink contains natural particulates and is not formulated with the precise chemical properties, extremely fine pigment size, and stabilizing agents required to flow through and not clog the printer's microscopic nozzles.
